correctness.rationale: Over algebraic closure, nonzero determinant forms span exactly degree q+1 part of the finite-plane point ideal. The gradient a×X^(q) has a single projective zero, p=a^(1/q); the local expansion gives multiplicity q for rank>1 and a repeated linear tangent. Restricting to arbitrary lines forces precisely Fq-line components through a. Degree-minus-one multiplicity forces residual irreducibility; Bezout tangency bounds show one branch, projection establishes rationality and genus the delta invariants. Normalization gives K-point counts. Exact verifier over F8 and F27 supports rank census, line factors, gradient locus and point counts; no finite-to-infinite inference is made.

Primary text sections 1--3 and 2009 Prop 2.1/2.3 inspected. Homma 2020 and Homma--Kim 2011 concern Fq-defined filling curves of other degrees or bounds. Targeted indexed-mathematics and literature searches found no dominating coverage; priority is provisional especially against Tallini 1961.

value.rationale: Classifies the complete minimum-degree linear system through all rational projective points after the natural base change; describes an intrinsic Drinfeld-arrangement-open irreducible stratum, middle reducible cusp stratum, characteristic-free higher q cusp multiplicities, and all finite-extension point counts. Also interprets system as reduced polars of the full finite-line arrangement. These are connected structural invariants of an intrinsically motivated system, not a routine bound or arbitrary parameter slice.
